name: Hawaii
agencyName: Hawaii (county-administered driver licensing; state common driver manual)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: 7 days after an online knowledge-test failure for lack of knowledge; county procedures may vary
retake.retakeFee: Full county online test fee applies again

gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 11 p.m.-5 a.m. (provisional), with exceptions
gdl.passengerLimits: No more than one passenger under 18 (household members excepted) for provisional holders

requiredDocuments: Proof of legal name and date of birth (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two documents proving Hawaii residency (for a REAL ID / gold star license)
Proof of legal presence if not a U.S. citizen
process.realIdNotes: Hawaii issues REAL ID-compliant (gold star) licenses. Bring proof of identity/legal presence, one proof of Social Security Number, and two proofs of Hawaii residential address. Applications are handled by your county licensing office (Honolulu, Hawaii, Maui, or Kauai).
process.permitFee: County-administered: Honolulu in-person written test $2 and instruction permit $5; online knowledge test $12 Honolulu, $11 Hawaii, $20 Kauai, or $25 Maui
process.licenseFee: Set by county and credential term
process.visionStandard: 20/40 with or without corrective lenses (screened at the licensing office)

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Hawaii does not use a numeric demerit-point system; abstract of convictions and serious/repeat offenses drive suspension or revocation
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow to a safe speed if you cannot, for stopped emergency, tow, and highway vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 60 mph (highest posted freeway limit; obey posted signs)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 25 mph in a marked school zone unless otherwise posted

references.citation: State of Hawaii Department of Transportation, Hawaii Driver's Manual
